Infectious causes are unlikely given negative cultures and histology; arterial ischemia is unlikely given palpable pulses; diabetic foot ulcer is unlikely by location and appearance. Other neutrophilic dermatoses (e.g., Sweet’s) typically present differently. Therefore the single most likely diagnosis is pyoderma gangrenosum.

[DIAGNOSIS] Pyoderma gangrenosum
